Revival of Engravers Old Black from 'Book of type specimens. Comprising a large variety of superior copper-mixed type' (Chicago, Barnhart bros. & Spindler, [1907]), leaf 480 (p. 462), Internet Archive item bookoftypespecim00barnrich (NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT). Traced from the printed specimen, never from digital font software; letters the specimen does not show are constructed from traced parts and flagged as such in the PHFD table. Version 0.1.0 (proto).
